purpose: Render versioned school documents (PDF, XLSX) from caller-supplied payloads using service-token authentication and template allowlists.

compatibility.safeAdditions: Add optional render options, new template keys, or delivery modes when existing clients keep valid behavior.
compatibility.breakingChanges: Coordinate HTTP contract, generated client, school API jobs, and template registry before removing or renaming fields.
compatibility.deprecation: Template keys remain available for an overlap period; HTTP majors version independently via path prefix.

physicalFreedom: PDF engine (Gotenberg, headless Chromium, or programmatic PDF), Excel engine, template storage layout, deployment topology, and async queue implementation remain adapter-owned.
Inline byte delivery and object-storage delivery may coexist; callers choose per request.

semantics.tenantAuthorization: schoolId is carried for namespacing and audit only; authority comes from the service token allowlist, not from database membership.
semantics.transaction: Render is side-effect-free except for optional artifact upload; no school business transaction is opened.
semantics.concurrency: Duplicate requests with the same idempotencyKey may return the same renderId and artifact hash.
semantics.idempotency: idempotencyKey is required; implementations should deduplicate within a bounded TTL.
semantics.orderingTiming: Synchronous render returns when bytes are ready; async jobs expose explicit status transitions.
semantics.observabilityCancellation: Logs may record templateKey, format, schoolId, renderId, and byte size; payloads, tokens, and artifact bytes must not be logged.
semantics.prohibitedBehavior: No school database access, no caller-provided HTML execution without sandboxing, no template access beyond token allowlist, no logging of secrets or document content.
